_comment: JEV-SHAPE template catalog. A LOOKUP TABLE of wave graph shapes, the same way rails_exec.json is a lookup table of tiers. Shape NAMES come from here at runtime; their descriptions (the criteria Jev reads) live in questions.json guards.shape. jev_shape.expand() turns a template into mission SKELETONS: id/band/class/tier/deps/readonly only. Note, targets and acceptance are still authored by the CTO seat. 'manual' is not a template: it is the fail-closed outcome (author the wave by hand, as before Jev). Source: harness/battleplan/notes/JEV_HELM.md.

solo.why: one coherent piece of work; one builder leg, no referee leg

fix-crux.why: ONE known fix that ships to artists; one builder leg, then the referee, no fan-out and no tidy (added 2026-09-20 after the H6 objective returned manual, split crux 0.56 / solo 0.44)

scout-synth.why: cause unknown; N read-only scouts in parallel, one synth leg that reads their receipts (BP7's shape)

build-screen-crux.why: several deliverables that ship; builders, then JEV-SCREEN, then the crucible, then tidy (BP3/BP4's shape)

probe-only.why: every deliverable is the output of a deterministic script or hython probe; zero model legs, wall-clock only
